conceptual_change: Introduce a mean-reversion signal using a 50-period Z-Score of the close price, targeting deviations above 2.0 standard deviations to capture potential overextension reversals.
rationale: Statistical arbitrage models for crypto frequently rely on Z-Score thresholds to define entry zones for mean reversion. Given the volatility of BTC, a 50-period window provides sufficient historical context to establish a baseline mean, while a threshold of 2.0 defines statistically significant extremes suitable for reversal signals.
